lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
stage.up: ▲ tap or tilt UP to pass ▲
stage.down: ▼ tap or tilt DOWN when they get it ▼
menu.title: Stick this phone on your forehead 😄
menu.intro: Screen facing your friends. They shout clues (or act them out — the deck says which). Tilt DOWN when you get it, UP to pass. 60 seconds. Then pass the phone!
ready.body: Hand the phone to the guesser. Type their name, put it on their forehead, tap Start.
end.title: {n} correct!
